project_name: VolailleStock - System de Gestion et Suivi de Stock de Poulets

primary.name: Deep Pine / Earthy Green
primary.usage: Main headers, active navigation, primary action buttons, status highlights

secondary.name: Terracotta / Warm Clay
secondary.usage: Key alert badges, primary CTA highlights, stock depletion warnings, sales submit actions

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (for raw chicken counts, e.g., 24.5 units)

key_features_and_flows.details: Simple passcode/password protected view with persistent session simulation or token.
Displays current available whole chickens in central workshop. Features 'Approvisionner l'atelier' weekly replenishment modal.
Card grid & list view of all sales points (e.g., 'Marché Central', 'Rotisserie Gare', 'Camion Mobile #1'). Displays current stock level in standard chicken count (decimated by halves, e.g. 18.5).
Quick wizard/modal to move whole chickens from central workshop to a selected POS.
Inter-POS stock transfer to balance inventory dynamically between locations.

key_features_and_flows.feature: Saisie des Ventes du Jour (End of Day Sales Entry)
key_features_and_flows.details: Intuitive mobile-first entry screen per POS. Input whole chickens sold + half chickens sold (e.g. 10 entiers + 3 demis = 11.5 chickens deducted). Live stock calculation preview.

key_features_and_flows.feature: Gestion des Points de Vente (POS Management)
key_features_and_flows.details: Add, edit, toggle active status, set minimum alert stock threshold for each point of sale.
Complete searchable ledger with filter tags: Approvisionnement, Distribution, Transfert, Vente, Réajustement.

layout_and_spacing.navigation: Header with warm glassmorphism backdrop-blur, brand logo 'VolailleStock', status drawer trigger, and mobile bottom bar for quick phone actions.
layout_and_spacing.container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 space-y-6
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layout_and_spacing.card_padding: p-5 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[#E2DDD5] bg-white shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200

components_strategy.mobile_optimization: Large tactile touch targets (min 44px), half-chicken step steppers (+0.5 / -0.5), quick numpad inputs, bottom sheet drawers for sales entry on mobile.

testing_attributes.rule: All buttons, inputs, modals, tabs, and stock counters MUST include clear data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is in French (Atelier, Point de Vente, Demis, Entiers, Mouvements, Transférer, Distribuer, Enregistrer les ventes).

Half chicken support is critical: display values as decimal (e.g., 14.5) or integer (15), and allow inputting both whole chickens (poulets entiers) and half chickens (demi-poulets). Calculate total sold as (entiers + 0.5 * demis).
Build clean API endpoints in FastAPI with persistent database (SQLite or memory state) for POS, Atelier stock, and history logs.
Implement mobile-first responsive UX with warm organic design tone (#2C4030 primary, #C85A32 secondary, #F7F5F0 base).
Add testid attributes to all interactive elements.
